mchjong.ponder.table_equipment.text_1: Prepare the tiles required by the rules: 136 for four players or 108 for three, with matching material, backs and face design. Spare tiles may stay in the box.
mchjong.ponder.table_equipment.text_2: Right-click the table to open its storage. It holds up to two mahjong boxes inside.
mchjong.ponder.table_equipment.text_3: Use a cloth on the table. A cloth and a complete set make the table ready for play.
mchjong.ponder.table_equipment.text_4: Open the side drawers to store point sticks and hand payments to the other players.
mchjong.ponder.table_equipment.text_5: Manage boxes through table storage in the lobby. Crouch-click the tabletop with empty hands to collect the cloth.
mchjong.ponder.table_placement.text_1: Leave a clear 3 x 3 area for the table, with room above its playing surface.
mchjong.ponder.table_placement.text_2: Place the table at the center of this area. Its frame fills the surrounding space.
mchjong.ponder.table_placement.text_3: Place stools two blocks from the center, on the sides used by your game.
mchjong.ponder.table_placement.text_4: Both ordinary and automatic tables use this compact arrangement.
mchjong.ponder.table_playing.text_1: Click a stool to sit and open the table controls. Click it again to reopen the controls while seated.
mchjong.ponder.table_playing.text_2: Choose three- or four-player mahjong and a rule preset in the lobby, then have every player ready up.
mchjong.ponder.table_playing.text_3: On an ordinary table, sweep the loose tiles to shuffle, drag them toward your wall, then pull wall tiles toward your hand.
mchjong.ponder.table_playing.text_4: An automatic table handles shuffling, wall construction, dealing and drawing for you.
mchjong.ponder.table_playing.text_5: Select tiles on the table to discard. The controls offer legal calls, riichi and winning actions.
mchjong.ponder.table_playing.text_6: Close the overlay to look around while seated. Use Minecraft's sneak control after closing it to dismount.
mchjong.ponder.workshop_dyeing.text_1: One dye colors two targets in a mixer and basin. Each target is a whole tile stack or one box. Two boxes and one blue dye color both complete sets.
mchjong.ponder.workshop_dyeing.text_2: Only the tile backs change. Faces, red fives, material, names, point sticks and dice remain intact. Glass tiles become tinted glass.
mchjong.ponder.workshop_dyeing.text_3: One undo dye removes back coloring from two targets. Both targets must actually change; an unchanged batch does not start or consume dye.
mchjong.ponder.workshop_dyeing.text_4: On a belt or depot, a deployer applies red dora dye to one ordinary five at a time. Undo dye restores one red five without changing its back.
mchjong.ponder.workshop_dyeing.text_5: A mixer marks 16 identical blank sticks with one dye: white 100, blue 1000, yellow 5000, red 10000 or black -10000.
mchjong.ponder.workshop_production.text_: A mechanical saw cuts 24 blank tiles per material. Six materials make 144 tiles. A bone block also yields 32 blank point sticks.
Mix black, red, green, blue and white dyes for two mahjong dyes. Mixing a red or black dye yields eight red dora or undo dyes.
To assemble a box, apply leather to a chest with a deployer, apply an iron nugget, then press it. This route saves the wooden slabs.
Under a mechanical press, supply one empty box, 144 identical blank tiles, one mahjong dye and a printing plate. The plate selects Kansai or Kanto faces.
The press returns the printing plate with the complete 144-tile box. Route the plate back for the next batch. Material, backs and names are retained.
A press and basin can also pack tiles, marked sticks and dice into a box. Existing slot limits apply. Route the finished box directly to the table.

rules.mchjong.option.abortive_draws.desc: Enables mid-hand abortive draws: kyushu kyuhai, suufon renda, suukaikan, and yojin riichi
rules.mchjong.option.agari_yame.descript: Ends match immediately when the dealer in the final hand wins while holding first place and target score
rules.mchjong.option.award_final_deposit: Awards any unclaimed riichi stick table deposits to the overall match winner
rules.mchjong.option.bankruptcy.descript: Concludes the match immediately when any player drops below 0 points; exactly 0 points continues
rules.mchjong.option.calls_clear_furiten: Clears temporary same-turn furiten whenever any player makes an intervening call
rules.mchjong.option.compound_yakuman.de: Multiplies payments when a single hand satisfies multiple distinct yakuman simultaneously
rules.mchjong.option.delayed_open_kan_do: Flips open kan dora after the replacement discard rather than immediately upon kan declaration
rules.mchjong.option.double_wind_pair_fu: Scores a pair of seat and round double wind tiles as 4 fu instead of 2 fu
rules.mchjong.option.double_yakuman.desc: Scores suuankou tanki, kokushi musou 13-wait, pure chuuren, and daisuushii as double yakuman
rules.mchjong.option.extension.descripti: Extends match into extra wind rounds if no player reaches the target score threshold at final hand
Adjusts placement bonuses based on how many players finish at or above return points
rules.mchjong.option.floating_uma.descri: Placement bonus when %s players finish at or above return points: rank %s bonus (points)
rules.mchjong.option.formal_tenpai_ignor: Considers a hand in tenpai at exhaustive draw even if all four winning tiles are completely visible
rules.mchjong.option.head_bump.descripti: When multiple players call ron on the same tile, only the closest player in turn order wins
rules.mchjong.option.ippatsu.description: Awards 1 additional han when winning within one unbroken turn cycle after declaring riichi
rules.mchjong.option.ippatsu_counts_towa: Allows ippatsu to count toward satisfying multi-han minimum restrictions
rules.mchjong.option.kan_dora.descriptio: Reveals an additional dora indicator tile in the dead wall for each declared kan
rules.mchjong.option.kazoe_yakuman.descr: Scores regular hands totaling 13 or more han as a full yakuman rather than sanbaiman
rules.mchjong.option.kiriage_mangan.desc: Rounds 3-han 60-fu and 4-han 30-fu scores up to a full mangan
rules.mchjong.option.kuitan.description: Permits completing the all-simples (tanyao) yaku with an open hand through chi, pon, or open kan
rules.mchjong.option.match_length.descri: Duration of match across rounds: tonpuusen (East only) or hanchan (East and South)
rules.mchjong.option.min_han.description: Minimum yaku han required to legally declare a win, excluding dora
rules.mchjong.option.min_riichi_wall.des: Minimum remaining tiles in the wall required to legally declare riichi
rules.mchjong.option.nagashi_allows_call: Allows the claimant to make open calls without disqualifying their nagashi mangan
rules.mchjong.option.nagashi_mangan.desc: Awards mangan value if a player's discards are all uncalled terminal and honor tiles at exhaustive draw
rules.mchjong.option.needs_riichi_deposi: Requires holding at least 1000 points to declare riichi without going into debt
rules.mchjong.option.pao_ron_honba_by_di: When a liable hand wins by ron off another player, all honba bonus is paid by the discarder
rules.mchjong.option.pao_tsumo_honba_sha: Splits tsumo honba payments among non-liable players when compounded with non-liable yakuman
rules.mchjong.option.red_fives.descripti: Configuration of red five bonus tiles included in the wall
rules.mchjong.option.renhou_mangan.descr: Scores Blessing of Man (ron before first draw without calls) as a mangan
rules.mchjong.option.replacement_capacit: Maximum number of replacement tiles available in the dead wall
rules.mchjong.option.return_points.descr: Benchmark score for standings; points above starting points fund the first-place bonus (oka)
rules.mchjong.option.riichi_kan_keeps_me: Prohibits concealed kan after riichi if it alters the hand's original meld interpretation
rules.mchjong.option.riichi_kan_keeps_ya: Prohibits concealed kan after riichi if it eliminates any existing yaku
rules.mchjong.option.rob_concealed_kan.d: Allows kokushi musou to win by chankan on an opponent's concealed kan declaration
rules.mchjong.option.rob_north_without_k: In 3-player mahjong, permits any hand waiting on North to win off an opponent's nuki call
rules.mchjong.option.round_shared_placem: Assigns indivisible 100-point placement remainder bonuses in turn order from original East
rules.mchjong.option.shared_ranks.descri: Divides placement points equally among tied players rather than breaking ties by dealer wind priority
rules.mchjong.option.starting_points.des: Initial point total distributed to each player at match start
rules.mchjong.option.suukantsu_pao.descr: Assigns pao liability to the player who feeds the fourth and final open kan
rules.mchjong.option.target_points.descr: Minimum score required for the leading player to conclude the match without extra extension rounds
rules.mchjong.option.triple_ron_draw.des: Aborts the hand as an abortive draw if three players call ron on the same tile simultaneously
rules.mchjong.option.uma.description: Placement bonus or penalty for rank %s in raw points (+10 is entered as 10000)
rules.mchjong.option.ura_dora.descriptio: Flips the underlying indicator tiles of each revealed dora indicator when winning with riichi
rules.mchjong.option.whole_hand_pao.desc: Makes the liable player pay for all compound yakuman, not merely the triggering yakuman
rules.mchjong.option.yakuless_furiten.de: Triggers temporary furiten even when passing on a winning tile that lacks qualifying yaku
